# Widget Resource

## Get Widget
<Route method="GET">/guilds/[\{guild.id\}](/developers/resources/guild#guild-object)/widget</Route>

Returns a widget.

## Modify Widget
<Route method="PATCH">/guilds/[\{guild.id\}](/developers/resources/guild#guild-object)/widget</Route>

## Get Widget Message
<Route method="GET">/channels/[\{channel.id\}](/developers/resources/channel#channel-object)/messages/[\{message.id\}](/developers/resources/message#message-object)</Route>

## Execute Widget Webhook
<Route method="POST">/webhooks/[\{webhook.id\}](/developers/resources/webhook#webhook-object)/[\{webhook.token\}](/developers/resources/webhook#webhook-object)</Route>

## Get Pinned Widgets (deprecated)
<Route method="GET">/channels/\{channel.id\}/pins</Route>

## Get Sparkle
<Route method='get'>
  /sparkles/\{sparkle\_id\}?with_counts=true
</Route>

## Get Secret Widget
<Route method="GET">/secret-widgets</Route>

## Delete Widget
<Route method="DELETE">/guilds/[\{guild.id\}](/developers/resources/guild#guild-object)/widget</Route>
